title: Multi-Level Market Making with Reinforcement Learning
useful_principle: FIFO/partial fills, multi-level actions, wealth-change reward and terminal liquidation
implementation_status: Implemented simplified two-level discrete quoting and tabular Q-learning; no actor-critic, logistic-normal allocation or deep-set encoder.

title: Market Making under a Weakly Consistent Limit Order Book Model
useful_principle: Order-type direction consistency and price-time priority
implementation_status: FIFO matching and event-local direction/volume tests; not the full marked-point-process/HJB-QVI model.

title: An Impulse Control Approach to Market Making in a Hawkes LOB Market
useful_principle: Clustered mutually exciting arrivals and discrete interventions
implementation_status: Two-type exponential Hawkes trade arrivals, hold/cancel/requote/hedge actions; no fitted ten-type LOB, PPO, self-imitation or HJB-QVI solver.

title: Reinforcement Learning Approaches to Optimal Market Making
authors: Gasperov, Begusic, Posedel Simovic and Kostanjcar
implementation_status: Used for the state/action/reward and baseline design; survey performance claims are not transferred to Bitcoin.

title: Option market making with hedging-induced market impact
useful_principle: Option inventory/hedge feedback, permanent versus transient impact and manipulation checks
implementation_status: Future coupled options module; current hypothetical gamma experiment remains separate. Options quotes, contract terms, hedge timing and signed-position assumptions are required.

title: Learning Market Making with Closing Auctions
useful_principle: Explicit terminal liquidity event and inventory management
implementation_status: Executable terminal liquidation is adopted, not a closing auction. This continuous Bitcoin sandbox has no auction mechanism; an auction would need a venue-specific extension.

title: Online Market Making and the Value of Observing the Order Book
useful_principle: Action-dependent feedback and value of book observations
implementation_status: Retained as a future observation/partial-feedback experiment. No-trade observations do not identify private trader valuations in our aggregate data; no regret theorem is claimed.

title: Foreign Exchange Volatility and the Bubble Formation in Financial Markets: Evidence From The COVID-19 Pandemic
useful_principle: SADF/GSADF right-tailed explosiveness tests on long daily series
implementation_status: Deferred to a separate macro/regime diagnostic requiring long contiguous data and appropriate critical values; not a short-horizon price or RL engine.

title: Market making and liquidity provision: The role of market makers in financial markets
useful_principle: General inventory, liquidity and operational-risk overview
implementation_status: Background context, not a specific fitted algorithm or empirical Bitcoin calibration source.

title: The hidden role of market-making in the rise of farmed salmon
useful_principle: Consumer demand and marketing in salmon markets
implementation_status: Excluded from financial matching/learning implementation: market-making has a different meaning here.
